clue.text: Lip-read to provide all the parts of a solid

definitions.text: Lip-read to provide all the parts of a solid

parts.words: Lip-read to provide all the parts
parts.note: the letters of 'lip-read' are the only letters used, each as often as needed, to spell the whole answer
the answer is a name for a geometric solid

explanation.surface: Someone reads lips to piece together every part of something solid.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer uses only the seven distinct letters P, A, R, L, E, I, D, which are exactly the letters of LIP-READ, repeated as often as needed.
explanation.definitionFit: A parallelepiped is a six-faced prism whose faces are all parallelograms, a standard shape in solid geometry.

clue.text: Bigot with a pronounced aversion to Buddhists or warrior princesses, depending on whom you talk to?

explanation.walkthrough: Xena: Warrior Princess was a 1990s TV series. The X is said like Z, so some hear Zen-o-phobe and others Xena-phobe, hence 'depending on whom you talk to'.

clue.text: Don is still in bed, after coming back

clue.text: Bag of wine
